definitions.gloss: turning off the lights; lights out
definitions.explanation: The act of switching off lights, or the designated time when lights are turned off, especially in institutional settings like dormitories, hospitals, or camps.

examples.japanese: {消灯|しょうとう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十時|じゅうじ}です。
examples.english: Lights out is at ten o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消灯|しょうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the hospital, lights go out at nine.

examples.japanese: {消灯|しょうとう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦こっそり→こっそり：05890_kossori⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Even after lights out, I was secretly reading a book under the covers.

notes:
FORMS:
{消|しょう} (extinguish) + {灯|とう} (light, lamp).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消灯|しょうとう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: lights-out time
- {消灯|しょうとう}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after lights out
- {消灯|しょうとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn off the lights

USAGE:
Primarily used in institutional contexts where lights-out is a scheduled event:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospitals
- ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧: dormitories
- ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧: military barracks
- ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧: summer camps

For everyday home use, ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (turn off the light) is more natural than {消灯|しょうとう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消灯|しょうとう}: turning off lights (formal/institutional)
- ⟦{点灯|てんとう}→点灯：17477_tentou⟧: turning on lights (opposite)
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧: turn off the light (everyday)
